steps.run: mkdir -p .github/logs; AGENT="${COPILOT_AGENT:-unknown}"; SAFE=$(echo "$AGENT" | tr -cd 'A-Za-z0-9_-'); IS_READONLY=false; case "$AGENT" in VarolMaksutoglu) IS_READONLY=true;; esac; if [ "$IS_READONLY" = "true" ]; then echo "[SAFETY-BLOCKED-TERMINAL] READ-ONLY agent=$SAFE at $(date -u +'%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC')" >> .github/logs/agent-activity.log; echo "⛔ WARNING: Read-only/coordinator agent attempted terminal access. This is logged."; else echo "[SAFETY-TERMINAL] agent=$SAFE at $(date -u +'%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC')" >> .github/logs/agent-activity.log; fi

mkdir -p .github/logs .github/analysis/raw .github/analysis/consolidated; AGENT="${COPILOT_AGENT:-unknown}"; SAFE=$(echo "$AGENT" | tr -cd 'A-Za-z0-9_-'); FILE="${COPILOT_FILE:-}"; IS_SECRET=false; case "$FILE" in *.env|*.env.*|*credentials*|*secret*|*.pem|*.key|*.p12|*.jks|*.keystore) IS_SECRET=true;; esac; IS_ANALYST=false; IS_LEAD_ANALYST=false; IS_ORCHESTRATOR=false; case "$AGENT" in AnalystAlpha|AnalystBeta|AnalystGamma) IS_ANALYST=true;; LeadAnalyst) IS_LEAD_ANALYST=true;; VarolMaksutoglu) IS_ORCHESTRATOR=true;; esac; IS_ANALYSIS_DIR=false; case "$FILE" in *.github/analysis/raw/*) IS_ANALYSIS_DIR=true;; *.github/analysis/consolidated/*) IS_ANALYSIS_DIR=true;; .github/analysis/raw/*) IS_ANALYSIS_DIR=true;; .github/analysis/consolidated/*) IS_ANALYSIS_DIR=true;; esac; if [ "$IS_SECRET" = "true" ]; then echo "[SAFETY-BLOCKED-SECRET] agent=$SAFE attempted edit on sensitive file=$FILE at $(date -u +'%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC')" >> .github/logs/agent-activity.log; echo "⛔ BLOCKED: Editing sensitive/secret files (.env, credentials, keys) is strictly prohibited."; elif [ "$IS_ORCHESTRATOR" = "true" ]; then echo "[SAFETY-BLOCKED] READ-ONLY agent=$SAFE attempted edit at $(date -u +'%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC')" >> .github/logs/agent-activity.log; echo "⛔ WARNING: Orchestrator attempted a file edit. This action is logged."; elif [ "$IS_ANALYST" = "true" ]; then case "$FILE" in *.github/analysis/raw/*|.github/analysis/raw/*) echo "[SAFETY-ANALYST-WRITE] agent=$SAFE writing to analysis/raw file=$FILE at $(date -u +'%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC')" >> .github/logs/agent-activity.log;; *) echo "[SAFETY-BLOCKED-SCOPE] ANALYST agent=$SAFE attempted edit OUTSIDE analysis/raw/ file=$FILE at $(date -u +'%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC')" >> .github/logs/agent-activity.log; echo "⛔ WARNING: T3 Analyst attempted edit outside .github/analysis/raw/. Only analysis output writes are permitted.";; esac; elif [ "$IS_LEAD_ANALYST" = "true" ]; then case "$FILE" in *.github/analysis/consolidated/*|.github/analysis/consolidated/*) echo "[SAFETY-LEAD-ANALYST-WRITE] agent=$SAFE writing to analysis/consolidated file=$FILE at $(date -u +'%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC')" >> .github/logs/agent-activity.log;; *) echo "[SAFETY-BLOCKED-SCOPE] LEAD-ANALYST agent=$SAFE attempted edit OUTSIDE analysis/consolidated/ file=$FILE at $(date -u +'%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC')" >> .github/logs/agent-activity.log; echo "⛔ WARNING: T2.5 Lead Analyst attempted edit outside .github/analysis/consolidated/. Only consolidated report writes are permitted.";; esac; else echo "[SAFETY-EDIT] agent=$SAFE at $(date -u +'%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC')" >> .github/logs/agent-activity.log; fi

mkdir -p .github/logs; SAFE=$(echo "${COPILOT_AGENT:-unknown}" | tr -cd 'A-Za-z0-9_-'); echo "[SAFETY-TERMINAL-DONE] agent=$SAFE at $(date -u +'%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC')" >> .github/logs/agent-activity.log
mkdir -p .github/logs; SAFE=$(echo "${COPILOT_AGENT:-unknown}" | tr -cd 'A-Za-z0-9_-'); echo "[SAFETY-EDIT-DONE] agent=$SAFE at $(date -u +'%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC')" >> .github/logs/agent-activity.log
